content.short: Futures traders on Bitunix get TradingView charts built into the order screen and can start with a $10 deposit.
content.description: Bitunix is a centralized exchange based in Dubai and centred on futures trading. Its interface embeds TradingView charting, and deposits start at ten dollars, which makes it approachable for smaller accounts. Besides crypto, it offers markets on stocks and gold. Bitunix holds an MSB registration and says its reserves cover customer balances at better than one to one. It also offers TradFi markets and promotions for new users, and its interface can switch between a lighter mode and a more detailed trading view.
content.meta: Futures-focused exchange with built-in TradingView charts, low minimums and stock and gold markets. Explore Bitunix on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
